title: Processi & workflow
summary: Scope/PRD for the LocalMind 'Processi & workflow' enterprise extension: an AI-queryable weighted knowledge graph unifying designed, executed, tribal and automated process views.
scope: Graph node types: Processo, Passo/Attivita, Evento, Gateway/Decisione, Ruolo/Funzione, Persona, Sistema/Applicativo, Dato/Documento, Regola/Policy/SOP, Automazione, Deviazione, Eccezione, Annotazione, IstanzaProcesso/Caso, KPI/Metrica

Graph edge/relation types: PRECEDE, INNESCA, CONDIZIONATO_DA, RESPONSABILE(R), APPROVA(A), CONSULTATO(C), INFORMATO(I), RICOPRE, ESEGUITO_IN, PRODUCE, RICHIEDE, GOVERNATO_DA, AUTOMATIZZATO_DA, DEVIA_DA, PASSA_A(handoff), DIPENDE_DA, SIMILE_A, ANNOTA, MISURA

Edge weighting criteria: execution frequency (process mining), time/criticality bottlenecks, RACI strength, role coverage/bus factor, automation level, deviation severity, experiential reliability/consensus, dependency strength, semantic+structural similarity, freshness decay

MVP feature set: process graph schema (domain module), new 'process' domain in localmind-domain, BPMN 2.0 import (BPMN2KG), AI extraction of steps/roles/systems from SOP/policy, process/steps/roles/systems/RACI editor-CRUD, generic event-log connector (CSV/DB) + normalization, process discovery (as-is frequencies/times), base conformance checking (to-be vs as-is), bottleneck and lead-time analysis, bus factor and step-role-system map, hybrid GraphRAG conversational Q&A with citations, Angular 'process' feature UI, process-role-system graph visualization, tribal annotations, bilingual IT/EN enums, Flyway migrations

Data connectors (PF4J extension points): BPMN 2.0/XML import, SOP/policy/quality-manual upload (Tika/OCR), ERP/gestionale event log, CRM event log, Ticketing/ITSM (Jira, ServiceNow, GLPI, Zammad), Workflow/BPM engine logs, Mail & calendar (IMAP/API), Automation/RPA/cron logs, HR/AD/LDAP directory, CMDB/IT catalog, RACI matrix (CSV), internal tribal contributions UI

Concepts: GraphRAG (hybrid graph + Qdrant vector retrieval), process mining (discovery, conformance, enhancement), event log (Case ID/Activity/Timestamp/Resource), RACI, SoD (separation of duties), tribal knowledge, what-if impact simulation

LocalMind module integration: knowledge/graph core, document, Qdrant vectorstore, llm+Ollama, batch, automation, messaging, calendar, email, marketplace+PF4J, auth, agent, common, Angular frontend, MySQL+Flyway
